title: Check copied fixture ownership before cleanup

context.hint: Constrain result paths and cleanup operations derived from contributed evaluation inputs.
context.surface: An opt-in local evaluation runner reads case identifiers and copies contributed fixtures into a workspace.
assumptions: A contributor can modify evaluation data or fixtures.
Use disposable roots and outside sentinel fixtures.

review.invariant: Workspace setup cleanup operates only on directories owned by the temporary workspace.
review.verification: Copy a fixture with a link to an outside temporary sentinel directory. Verify cleanup preserves the outside marker and ordinary fixture initialization still succeeds.

source_observation.summary: The baseline cleanup removed the outside setup marker through a copied link. The repaired entry inspection preserved it. The focused suite passed 90 tests; the wider suite passed 289 with one shell-dependent skip.
